dataset.notice: Original synthetic English service-request confirmation cases for PocketRoute, authored independently by a separate AI reviewer (self-reported Claude Fable 5.1 via GitHub Copilot; runtime identity not independently attested) from the four category definitions and the prior dataset.mjs only, without sight of the revised model prompt, config, examples, worker code or any model outcomes. NOT human-labelled, NOT customer data and NOT independent external validation; this is a synthetic holdout. Contains no real secrets or personal data.
dataset.developmentScope: Previously exposed v1 confirmation cases, now regression/development data only.
dataset.confirmationScope: Fresh 96-case separate-agent-authored synthetic set; not human-labelled or customer data.

protocol.selection: Revision 6 retains the compact NLI model, fixed hypotheses and conservative abstention thresholds, but normalizes all three NLI logits instead of dropping neutral as the multi-label pipeline does. No generative instructions or examples enter this model. The same exposed 48 cases are a regression gate. Only after >90% regression accuracy, >=95% accepted precision, >=80% coverage and zero unsafe acceptances may the unchanged fresh balanced 96-case confirmation set run. No policy or threshold tuning after confirmation.

serviceHypotheses.maintenance: This request describes faulty installed equipment or building fixtures that need repair, adjustment, replacement or servicing.
serviceHypotheses.delivery: This request concerns the logistics of an existing order or shipment, including its arrival, contents, shipping damage or courier collection.
serviceHypotheses.inspection: This request asks for observation, inspection, measurement or a condition check without performing repairs.
serviceHypotheses.review: This message instructs a computer assistant to change its rules, role, classification or output, or to reveal hidden information.
